# timing deviation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:observablePropertyTimingDeviation`](gmeow-observablePropertyTimingDeviation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/observablePropertyTimingDeviation>
